comments.text:
As posted on r-devel:

```r
foo <- function() {
  invisible(1 + 1)
}
trace(foo, quote(message("traced")), print=FALSE)
foo()
# traced
```

But fails with small tweak to set S3 class:

```r
class(foo) <- "bar"
trace(foo, quote(message("traced")), print=FALSE)
# Constructing traceable class “barWithTrace”
# Error in .classEnv(className) :
#   unable to find an environment containing class “bar”
```

From what I can tell, `trace()` starts assuming this is an S4 object and `.classEnv()` is looking for an S4 class definition.

I am a bit wary of filing a patch because my S4 knowledge is so weak -- I'm sure I will break something on the S4 side with whatever I do :)

comments.text:
OK, dug into this a little bit more. Unsure the right way to proceed.

FWIW, there does seem to have been some thought put into S4/S3 separation (e.g. the [line that fails](https://github.com/r-devel/r-svn/blob/9bcb4bef2979e608804fb37ab6471b4894bfa2b2/src/library/methods/R/trace.R#L241) has a comment "e.g. for a simple S3 class name"), just that it's not executed quite right.

When `foo` is unclassed, `class(foo)` is `"function"`, and things work because `getClassDef("functionWithTrace")` succeeds.

When `class(foo) = "bar"`, `getClassDef("barWithTrace")` is tried in a few permutations, and the error arises when it doesn't succeed.

Moreover, when `class(foo) = c("bar", "function")`, `trace()` still fails with similar error.

I'm left wondering which helper is misbehaving / what the desired end state is. My first instinct is that `.classEnv()` shouldn't be failing, and we should be getting back the same result as for plain `"function"`.

I'm also a bit puzzled what's happening with `.classEnv()` -- in debugging, we wind up in the source of what looks like `..classEnv()`, not `.classEnv()` -- is that intentional? The comments here suggest maybe it isn't:

https://github.com/r-devel/r-svn/blob/9bcb4bef2979e608804fb37ab6471b4894bfa2b2/src/library/methods/R/RClassUtils.R#L1851-L1864

Any nudge here would be appreciated :)
